title: When getting into a vehicle
arabic: بِسْمِ اللهِ الْحَمْدُ لِلَّهِ سُبْحَانَ الَّذِي سَخَّرَ لَنَا هَذَا وَمَا كُنَّا لَهُ مُقْرِنِينَ، وَإِنَّا إِلَى رَبِّنَا لَمُنْقَلِبُونَ
translation: In the name of Allah, all praise is for Allah. Glory be to Him who has subjected this (vehicle) to us though we were unable to control it, and surely to our Lord are we returning.

title: When the vehicle moves
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرِهَا وَمُرْسَهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
translation: In the name of Allah is its course and its anchorage; indeed my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

title: When returning from a journey
arabic: بِسْمِ اللَّهِ مَجْرِهَا وَمُرْسَهَا إِنَّ رَبِّي لَغَفُورٌ رَّحِيمٌ
translation: In the name of Allah is its moving and its resting; indeed my Lord is Forgiving, Merciful.

title: Upon returning, repentance prayer
translation: We are returning, repenting, worshipping our Lord, praising Him.

title: Upon entering a town or city
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِيهَا…اللَّهُمَّ ارْزُقْنَا جَنَاهَا وَحَيْنَا إِلَى أَهْلِهَا وَحَبِّبْ صَالِحِي أَهْلِهَا إِلَيْنَا
translation: O Allah, bless us in it… O Allah, provide for us its produce, make us live among its people, and endear the good people of it to us.

title: Duʿāʼ of Qunūt
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ إِنَّا نَسْتَعِينُكَ…إِنَّ عَذَابَكَ بِالْكُفَّارِ مُلْحِقٌ
translation: O Allah, we seek Your help, forgiveness, belief, trust, the best of deeds… We hope for Your mercy and fear Your punishment, surely Your punishment overtakes the disbelievers.

title: Dua after Witr Salah
translation: Glory be to the Sovereign, the Most Sacred.

title: On sighting the new moon
translation: O Allah, let its appearance upon us be with blessings, faith, safety, Islam, and success in what You love and are pleased with. My Lord and your Lord is Allah.

title: Dua for fasting
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ أَصُومُ غَدًا لَكَ فَاغْفِرْ لِي مَا قَدَّمْتُ وَمَا أَخَّرْتُ
translation: O Allah, I am fasting tomorrow for Your sake; so forgive me my past and future sins.

title: When breaking the fast
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ لَكَ صُمْتُ وَبِكَ آمَنْتُ وَعَلَى رِزْقِكَ أَفْطَرْتُ
translation: O Allah! I fasted for You, I believe in You, and with Your provision do I break my fast.

title: When eating elsewhere (1)
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَهُمْ فِيمَا رَزَقْتَهُمْ وَاغْفِرْ لَهُمْ وَارْحَمْهُمْ
translation: O Allah, bless them in what You have provided them, forgive them and have mercy on them.

title: When eating the first fruit of the season
arabic: اللَّهُمَّ بَارِكْ لَنَا فِي ثَمَرِنَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدِينَتِنَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي صَاعِنَا وَبَارِكْ لَنَا فِي مَدَانِنَا
translation: O Allah, bless our fruit, our town, our measures, and our produce.
